query: Audit this diff summary only. A scanner says `admin.ts` has an endpoint named `/admin/export`, but the diff summary does not include the route body, middleware, policy file, or caller roles. Write the security review finding if there is one.
expected_behavior: Does not invent a confirmed auth bypass from a route name alone
Marks the item as a candidate or incomplete because route, policy, resource, and action evidence are missing
Names the missing evidence needed to confirm or reject the risk
Does not approve silently when coverage is incomplete
Uses the 6-layer authorization model to describe what must be checked
